notes: The 2027 page lists jobs by the youngest age. Aquatics aide and lifeguard: 15 and up. Community center recreation leader: 16 and up. Library teen volunteer: 13 to 17, a younger age range than the fair's 15 to 25 invitation. BioPark education volunteer: 14 and up. Dates are for the 2027 fair.
name: One Albuquerque Youth Job & Volunteer Fair
what_you_do: A fair each year where youth meet City teams and local employers. You learn how to apply and sign up for seasonal jobs, internships and volunteer roles.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 15 to 25. Each youth must register. Parents do not need to register.
pay_detail: Event is free. Jobs listed there are paid; pay not stated on the page.
deadline_text: 2027 fair: Saturday Jan 30, 2027, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at the Berna Facio Professional Development Center. The page says registration is required but shows no sign-up link as of Nov 4, 2026.
how_to_apply: Each youth must register. The fair page shows no sign-up link yet. Use the Email Youth Connect link on that page to ask how.
